name: – Leoluca Orlando – § 1, point u – Am 7
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy on promoting transnational governance on water in the interests of conflict prevention and peace
part_text: Aa. whereas universal, affordable and non-discriminatory access to water requires effective public policies for water services; whereas promoting responsible commercial stewardship and mitigating risks arising from market volatility is also important for ensuring water security; whereas universal access to safe drinking water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) services is essential for human dignity, public health and sustainable development and for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and should therefore be among the main priorities of the EU’s external action;
